comment: ANCHOR: INJECTION_TRIAGE_11_20261106 — SQL injection triage, batch 11 (tq-py-sql-fstring, operator-approved security
item 2026-11-06). memory_shadow_projector grants CONNECT with the database name quoted by psycopg2.sql.Identifier;
the shadow row count, the redeploy version lookup and the coordination ledger's column migration check every
interpolated identifier against a fixed allowlist or a strict identifier regex in the same function.
Hermetic: a recording fake cursor and a throwaway sqlite file, no database server.
